title: Approved survey basis
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Every enabled profile identifies purpose, material/calibration, applicable criterion and investigation setting, averaging area, decision rule, confidence and authority. Ore 0.30/0.40 Bq/cm² are the stated site example; yellowcake remains unset pending authorization.

title: Carry and deployment
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: One person can transfer the configured unit using the approved access/grip method or specified handling aid; proposed whole-unit 12 kg packaging ceiling remains subject to ergonomic/site reassessment.

title: Compact differential-drive base
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Two driven wheels, encoders and rear support carry the qualified head and cross the approved floor surface/seam/slope envelope without loss of support or window strike.

title: Stop distance and motion bounds
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Each authorized forward, reverse and pivot speed has a measured stopping envelope with positive clearance margin at worst mass, delay, adhesion and floor slope.

title: Personnel access, egress and trailer edge
basis: User use case / proposed safety controls
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Choose the operating mode and guard the elevated doorway whenever it is open. In qualified shared-space scanning and guidance, technicians may remain inside with safe egress and clearance from the active protective envelope. Secured empty surveys remain an option. Check the approved setup before enabling drive.

title: Angled advance drop warning
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Angled ranges detect credible upcoming floor discontinuities or degradation early enough to slow or stop within the verified clearance margin for each enabled motion.

title: Near edge stops
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Downward edge coverage protects vulnerable wheels/caster under permitted directions including oblique and pivot approaches. Stale, invalid or missing signals inhibit affected motion.

title: Contact protection
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Head wings, vulnerable perimeter and chassis contact zones trigger a local stop within the demonstrated margin; undiscovered blind zones constrain permitted motion.

title: Independent stop and reset
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: E-stop and required protective circuits retain authority with stalled ROS or missing head. No automatic restart after bus/remote reconnect, contact or latched cliff fault.

title: Closed doors and communications
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: In supervised commissioning hold on loss of a required operator link. After site qualification an armed unattended scan in a secured empty trailer continues through loss of an ordinary viewer or Wi-Fi session while required protective channels remain healthy. Loss of any required protective channel causes a local hold, alarm record and deliberate rearm.

title: Safe recovery
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Approved immobilized-unit recovery, safe entry, isolation and window protection are demonstrated in representative work geometry with no unsecured elevated access.

title: Localization and timing
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: LiDAR, encoders and IMU support verified localization in repetitive geometry. Pose and time errors must fit the signed spatial budget; untrusted intervals remain reported.

title: Whole floor accounting
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Plan to survey the entire floor; credit only valid sensed apertures and accepted exposure. Identify location and area of inaccessible, interrupted and insufficient-sensitivity regions.

title: Seam, perimeter and wall strips
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Use measured lane and edge response to plan repeat or offset passes. No centimeter of confirmed gap is hidden by display interpolation or vehicle footprint assumptions.

title: Removable indexed detector head
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Interchangeable head mounts on indexed datums with measured transform, repeatable protected standoff and positive retention; sensor wiring and data connectors disengage with drive/power isolated.

title: Optical topology
basis: User selected four / proposed four matched references
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Four independent lower floor lanes and four optically isolated reference channels are supported, with lane-specific gross streams/live time. Verify segment identity after swapping.

title: OEM detector optics
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Baseline requests bonded scintillator, guide and SiPM on carrier; own signal chain or optional supplier classifier preserves raw waveform access and characterized weak-pulse response.

title: Detector standoff
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Target a 10 mm entrance-film-to-level-floor gap on the loaded Rev D platform, with a 3 mm lower guard projection giving 7 mm ground clearance. Evaluate an optional 5 mm projection and 5 mm clearance. Measure loaded gap and dynamic excursions before fixing range or approving activity calibration.

title: Radiometric electrical acquisition
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Detect and record classes with known thresholds, characterized ADC clipping/pile-up, cross-channel leakage, live time and reset behavior. Threshold changes create a new acquisition epoch.

title: Independent photon compensation
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Model upper and lower stream response and covariance per lane/class. Quantify residual bias and charged-particle leakage in changing representative site fields; invalidate unqualified conditions.

title: Map in Bq/cm²
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Report channel-specific surface activity on the stated calibration basis, using production gap, window, guard and calibration. Retain uncertainty and raw counts, including signed corrected rates.

title: Moving sensitivity
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Demonstrate below 0.20 Bq/cm² moving detection limit for the signed ore patch, background, speed, standoff and probabilities. Compare separately with the site investigation setting.

title: Hotspot and uncertainty decisions
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Flag activity near/above site action levels, conditions with insufficient sensitivity, and inconclusive patches; support stationary recount and a bounded follow-up workflow.

title: Host/time contract
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: At initial handshake, establish head identity, boot/configuration and geometry for this connection and bind the calibration on the host. Ordinary count records carry sequence, monotonic bin boundaries, per-lane counts/live time, temperature and quality without recurring head or geometry identifiers. Record the host-side association and bound clock-to-pose error.

title: Acquisition loss and overload
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Reject duplicate, bad CRC and malformed frames, flag time gaps/reset, heater/thermal and overload events; invalid samples cannot fill coverage cells. Preserve degraded data for diagnosis.

title: Replay and raw records
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Store counts, reference stream, live times, pose, signed estimates, profile, firmware, calibration and decision versions and enough metadata to reproduce a survey offline.

title: Surface heat map and report
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Export activity density, uncertainty, coverage/exposure, localization and data validity, decision outcomes/recounts, time, calibration basis and unsurveyed regions; identify floor-only coverage.

title: Isolated electrical interface
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Head power and protected heater supply are sized for measured peaks, with keyed connections and isolated RS-485. Verify independent hardware bumper path across connection faults.

title: Warm-start winter operation
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Qualify warm-start operation at −20 °C ambient for agreed mission duration; −25 °C remains a separate stretch test. No assumed overnight cold-soak capability.

title: Independent heater controls
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Provide separate head/chassis heater controls and protection, log actual temperatures, and exclude operation outside measured performance/pack limits.

title: Energy budget and recovery reserve
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Measured power including motor, heater, sensor/compute, charge limits, cold operation and recount time meets approved mission duration and return/recovery reserve.

title: Electrical noise immunity
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Verify heater/drive PWM, braking/current peaks and supply droop leave counts/timing within approved error budgets. Controlled overload leads to a safe stop or explicit invalidation.

title: Housing, decontamination and service
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Guard and seal sensitive windows/electronics. Accessible wipeable surfaces, removable wear parts and site-approved cleaning protect clean areas and do not invalidate calibration undetected.

title: ROS 2 autonomy and simulation
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: A reproducible ROS 2/driver configuration supports simulated or real count inputs, survey orchestration, transforms and local safety supervision. Separate hardware protection works without ROS.

title: Profile units and change control
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Display explicit Bq/cm² units with authorized, versioned profiles, averaging basis and calibration references. Unit conversion and editing are deliberate. No unsupported yellowcake or release decision.

title: Pilot and release authority
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Site RP approves operating limits, reference comparisons, procedures, unresolved areas and operator roles before use. The robot identifies findings and retains supporting evidence.

title: Head independence and emulation
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: A standalone head on a bench and a dummy/emulated head on the robot both produce data consistent with the ICD; replacing a head requires its own geometry/calibration identity.

title: Data continuity and mission resume
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Store local checkpoints across resets/loss of radio; new epochs cannot bridge invalid position/acquisition gaps. Revisit the missed footprint or mark it unresolved.

title: Technician-guided hotspot tour
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Present stable hotspot IDs, trailer coordinates and status. On explicit Next, align the intended detector lane to the selected hotspot within a site-qualified tolerance, hold indefinitely and indicate Arrived. On final Next or explicit Park, travel to the validated parking point and hold. Preserve completed, deferred and unreachable outcomes; reject duplicate or stale commands.

title: Technician presence and close approach during guided follow-up
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: In a qualified shared-space tour, allow attendants to remain inside for Next, Expose and Park while clear of the validated moving protective envelope. Hold locally on intrusion or loss of protection. Positively inhibit and verify drive before reaching near the head, handling it or working in its motion envelope. Clear that envelope, deliberately restore permission and request the next move. An attempted command during inhibition cannot queue motion.

title: Shared browser-based operator interface
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Serve a responsive local browser UI to authorized phones and computers. Support concurrent read-only viewers and a single acknowledged command owner. Enforce roles, session/command expiry, reauthentication or handoff as specified, command receipts and an audit trail. Stale or repeated requests never advance two flags.

title: Local controls and status indications
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Provide physical power isolation, latching local E-stop, deliberate program start/resume and normal pause/stop. Provide labeled states distinguishable by symbols or patterns as well as color for Ready, Moving, Holding, Fault and Charging/Service. Stop release, network recovery and power restoration cannot start motion.

title: Qualified unattended survey operation
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: After deliberate arming, the robot can complete a qualified scan in a secured empty trailer while technicians perform other work. Detect local faults, inhibit unsafe motion, store data/checkpoints, and deliver or queue alerts to the designated responder. Operation has documented protected-access, response and recovery arrangements.

title: Field-removable battery
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: A gloved operator can isolate power, remove and swap the retained keyed and touch-protected battery with the robot stationary. The pack cannot be installed in reverse or move while latched. Archive the run before removal and require checks and deliberate restart after replacement.

title: Charge inlet and limited service mode
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Provide a protected keyed charge inlet, matched charger, pack-temperature charge gating and a power path validated for charging with compute services on. An independent charger-present/service inhibit prevents all traction. Authorized staff can read/export data and manage permitted settings; survey start and motion are unavailable.

title: Detector lab extension and source checks
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Supply a keyed, strain-relieved lab extension for separate head power/data and interlock functions. A positively selected BENCH configuration isolates traction with the detached head on a documented fixture. Distinguish routine source-response bump checks from efficiency calibration against a traceable source and from contact-bumper tests.

title: Dynamic head height and cantilever stability
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: At loaded mass with every permitted head and pack, measure wheel reactions, tip margin, static deflection, joint compliance and head-to-floor gap during acceleration, braking, turns and worst permitted seams. The measured gap remains within the calibrated interval or the host withholds affected coverage; structure, wheel loads and stop margin meet approved bounds.

title: Low protective rail and small obstruction response
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Trial a separately compliant low bumper 3 mm below the entrance film, at 7 mm ground clearance, with an alternative 5 mm vertical projection leaving 5 mm ground clearance. Challenge front, side, corner and inboard hazards with surrogates. Record guard coverage, residual penetration paths and nuisance holds; inspect the floor, protect the window and qualify any grille response.

title: Dedicated head MCU and electronic identification
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: A dedicated head MCU returns type, serial, firmware/boot identity and descriptor during the connection handshake. Retrieve and approve dimensions, active geometry, settings and compatibility before arming. Cache the result for the uninterrupted connection. Invalidate on disconnect, loss of continuity or reset. A fresh handshake precedes use of further counts. The head reports raw counts, timing and health. The host assigns identity and applies the approved Bq/cm² conversion.

title: Findable revisit marks and pose literacy
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: Display position and heading in a named trailer frame, the target and active sensing-lane footprints, positional uncertainty and the offset used for manual access. A technician using the floor datum and coordinates can relocate a blinded flag after the robot parks. Record failed or ambiguous visits for follow-up.

title: Shared-space scanning and hotspot guidance
requirement_and_acceptance_criterion: A technician may remain in the trailer during scan, Next, Expose and Park in the qualified shared-space mode. Verify separation and positive stopping clearance for a person approaching the swept body/head, all permitted directions and the narrowest usable aisle. Intrusion or a protective fault invokes the independent protective stop. Restrict routes or directions with inadequate clearance, account for blocked floor coverage, and require deliberate restart.
